replies.author: Rainstruck
replies.body:
So Kylo, being the good person he is,decided to actually listen and follow the new Minecraft EULA and made it so that everyone has access to the command. Basically it states that you cannot make people pay money to a server and you will get a strict advantage over other players for paying money. Kylo probably wanted to fix this so he made it so everyone can have that command.

Here is the kink if you want to read more:https://account.mojang.com/documents/minecraft_eula
